Firefly ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Oct 2026 • Couples
We had a wonderful dinner at Firefly Restaurant & Bar! ❤️ We actually walked past the restaurant at first and spent some time looking around for the perfect place for our last evening in Hoi An. In the end, we decided to walk back to Firefly, and we’re so happy we did!

The food was delicious, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and their recommendations were spot on. The service made the whole experience even more enjoyable, and we felt very well taken care of.

We’re so glad we chose Firefly for our last evening in Hoi An. Definitely a place we would recommend to anyone visiting the city! ✨
